text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—Behold Hillesta Academy's pride and joy: 
the gym facilities! 
It's about the size of four whole football 
fields!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's huge...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Hillesta Academy" was a renowned training 
club 
boasting one of the largest scales in the 
country. 
Thanks to Daring Heart's tour, we were 
able to visit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible, isn't it? 
After workouts, you can even get free 
protein drinks."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It has every single condition you could 
possibly need 
to mold the elites who will make 
a splash in the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And the girls raised in this environment—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! They're all moving so fast...! 
And their running form is so beautiful, 
too."
choice_data_list:
Those girls... are in elementary school, 
right...?

Those girls... are in elementary school, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Because they're forged to perfection 
in top-tier facilities, 
they're able to maintain top-class results 
even after entering Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's the foundation 
behind why trainees from clubs like this 
are so amazing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Right! They pour all the time they could 
spend playing with friends 
straight into working relentlessly toward 
their dreams."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Well... even so, whether they can take 
the top spot in the Twinkle Series is 
another story entirely."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I was pretty exceptional here myself, you 
know? 
I truly believed I was going to be a 
legendary horsegirl."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yet in the end, I never captured a 
Classic, 
nor did I win a GⅠ... It really is an 
unforgiving world."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you, okay? 
I just thought you of all people would 
understand."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The world we live in is exceedingly 
harsh. 
An immovable reality. 
Which is precisely why—it fires you up, 
doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I like to think I've seen with my own 
eyes 
just how tough of a horsegirl you really 
are."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You know full well 
how to overcome unforgiving environments."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To become a horsegirl who goes down in 
history— 
If it's you, you can make it come true. Do 
your best!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, thank you very much!
choice_data_list:
(Her expression still looks a little 
stiff, though...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Daring Heart, 
who said she was going to make the rounds 
greeting club coaches—

"Didn't I tell you already?! 
You absolute bottom feeder of a 
horsegirl!"

"That's it! I'm going in myself! 
I'll beat the scum right out of 
that slippery son of a bitch!"

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaaand cut! Yep, that was perfect! 
Win Marilyn, take a break!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her name was Win Marilyn. While actively 
pursuing 
an acting career, she was simultaneously 
enrolled at Tracen Academy, 
balancing two paths at once. And—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Tact! 
Oh no, did you see that just now?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, just a little bit. 
Good work out there, Win Marilyn."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was also a classmate of Daring Tact, 
and from what I had heard, 
the two seemed to be on quite friendly 
terms.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...It's public information, so I can tell 
you! 
Actually... I'm doing a guest appearance 
in a TV drama airing this autumn!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! Ever since that one drama, I've 
been getting 
flooded with offers for tough, feisty 
roles."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That drama was 'Delinquent Racer Yoko.' 
A massive blockbuster hit where a 
delinquent horsegirl played 
by Win Marilyn set the world right through 
racing.
choice_data_list: It was wildly popular, wasn't it...
It was wildly popular, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Even in Hidaka, on broadcast 
days, 
the entire neighborhood would stay glued 
to their living rooms."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly grateful for it. 
To be blessed with such a career-defining 
role..."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to give it my all for this next 
role, too!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
"Marilyn! Your acting just now was 
seriously amazing! 
Say, don't you think you could stick 
around 
for the next scene after all?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, thank you so much for the praise♪ 
But unfortunately, I really must pass."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I would love to accept, but... 
I'm aiming to debut within this year, so 
I've already 
scaled back my acting workload, you see~"

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
"Figures, what a shame! Still, 
I can't wait to see how *that* delinquent 
horsegirl 
runs in real life...! Best of luck out 
there!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Please do tuned in~! 
'The Tale of Racehorse Girl Win 
Marilyn'... 
You definitely mustn't miss it!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm going to create the most 
magnificent drama imaginable. 
—Along the resplendent Tiara path!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Win Marilyn is walking the Tiara path as 
well... 
I'm certain she will run magnificently.)"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Tact! Welcome back! 
The Ritto dorm girls aiming for the Tiara 
path 
are having a study session right now, 
wanna join?"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"—The issue is right here. If the early 
pace is fast, 
at what point will the frontrunners start 
collapsing?"

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like their breathing room runs 
out right before the third corner? 
Making a move there would require pretty 
ruthless judgment~"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I made a 3D model of the race 
developments 
from the last five years of the Oka Sho 
using specialized software. 
Wanna look at it while we discuss?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A 3-D model...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(It's not just Win Marilyn. 
Every single one of them is truly so 
brilliant...)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...An unforgiving world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact messaged me saying she was 
going for a light run. 
When I headed down to the track to watch 
over her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(My hometown nurtured this strength... I 
take pride in it. 
I have confidence in it, too... and 
yet...)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(Surrounded by so many brilliant runners, 
what... could I possibly accomplish? 
What am I capable of doing?)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(I don't know. But... I want to try my 
hardest. 
I want to catch up... No...)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I want to overtake them...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The acceleration Daring Tact unleashed in 
that moment— 
Watching her blaze across the turf with 
unbelievable leg speed 
left me completely breathless—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because the brilliance radiating from her—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —closely resembled *theirs*.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, even though I told you it 
would just be a light run... 
I ended up sprinting at full power."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decided against voicing the words that 
rose to mind. 
She had not even debuted yet... 
and was currently in the midst of 
absorbing everything she could.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —"You can win the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —"You can win the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Telling her that she possessed such 
dazzling brilliance... 
would only serve as a heavy burden right 
now.

title: Looking Up at a Cloudless Sky
